value.name: Marylin power walks with friends
value.description: Marylin walks the crowded San Vicente bike path with Sarah Sorkin and Ramona Barcelona, establishing the social setting.
evidence: Marylin power walks along the San Vicente Bike Path with her friends SARAH SORKIN and RAMONA BARCELONA.
It's early, but the path is crowded with bikers, bladers, runners, power walkers, wheelchair racers etc.

value.name: Sarah invites Marylin to beach house
value.description: Sarah asks Marylin to come to Barry's beach house the next day, prompting discussion of Barry's hidden assets.
evidence: SARAH You want to come out to the beach house tomorrow?
MARYLIN I didn't know Barry had a beach house.
SARAH Neither did I until my lawyer found it -- quite a paper trail -- he had it in the dog's name.

value.name: Marylin reveals she hired Ruth Rabino
value.description: Marylin tells her friends she hired Ruth Rabino to handle her case, and they praise Ruth's reputation.
evidence: RAMONA (To Marylin) So who'd you hire?
MARYLIN Ruth Rabino.
SARAH She's a legend. Didn't she do Kravis or a Pearlman? She definitely did a Factor.
MARYLIN She did a Harriman.

value.name: Marylin vows to nail Barry
value.description: Marylin declares that she and her investigator are determined to defeat Barry in the dispute.
evidence: MARYLIN In the words of my Private Investigator, we're going to nail his ass.

value.name: Ramona jokes about repeated pregnancies
value.description: Ramona jokes that she keeps having children to secure George, then mentions she may be pregnant again.
evidence: RAMONA I've been trying to nail George's for years, but he's very careful. I'll just keep having children. I think I'm pregnant, by the way.
SARAH Ramona! Don't get Mia Farrow on us.
RAMONA Three is not Farrow.

value.name: Marylin identifies Miles Massey as Rex's lawyer
value.description: The women discuss Rex's attorney, revealing that Marylin's opponent is represented by Miles Massey.
evidence: SARAH Who's Rex's guy?
MARYLIN Miles Massey.
SARAH Of Massey Myerson?
MARYLIN Do you know him?
SARAH By reputation.

value.name: Sarah praises Miles's legal victories
value.description: Sarah recognizes Miles as a famous divorce lawyer and cites his past success in securing assets for other clients.
evidence: He got Ann Rumsey that cute little island of George's.
George was so impressed he hired him when he divorced his second.

value.name: Ramona urges Marylin to get pregnant
value.description: Ramona advises Marylin to have a baby to strengthen her position in the divorce, but Marylin rejects the idea.
evidence: RAMONA You should have tried to get pregnant Marylin -- solidify your position.
MARYLIN No.
RAMONA You like kids.
MARYLIN I can't have a baby with a man I don't love... And I can't submit a child to divorce.
